user.title: Connect to Decaid
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the tablet running Decaid. Leave machine ID blank to match any machine; optionally enter its ID from /api/v1/devices.

reconfigure.title: Change Decaid connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the tablet running Decaid. Leave machine ID blank to match any machine; optionally enter its ID from /api/v1/devices.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname, without http:// or a port.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Decaid. Check the address, port, and that the tablet REST API is reachable.
error.unknown_machine: No machine with this ID is listed in /api/v1/devices. Check the ID, or leave it blank to match any machine.

abort.already_configured: This tablet endpoint is already configured.
abort.moved_to_new_tablet: This machine was already set up through another tablet. The existing Decent device now uses this tablet, keeping its entities and history.
